habitat: Evergreen forests; open woodland; mixed forest; and hilly/mountainous areas at 300–1800 m
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Reeves Pheasant (Syrmaticus reevesii) stands out. This species, part of the Phasianidae family, is a resident of Evergreen forests; open woodland; mixed forest; and hilly/mountainous areas at 300–1800 m. Its IUCN Red List status is Vulnerable (VU), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Reeves Pheasant is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Reeves Pheasant and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
